slots.rule: A household that moves out, takes a final bill, and is followed by a new occupant
slots.glossary: A home move: the leaving occupant gets a final bill, and whoever moves in next becomes the supplier's new customer at that address.
slots.reason: No household in this run can be shown moving. The published record carries no move-out event and no final-bill marker, and the new-occupant accounts (OCC-…) are not linked to the household they replaced, so a rule cannot follow a move from one occupant to the next. What closes it: the record now carries each move-out and final bill and names the household a new occupant replaced, so the next published run is the first that can fill this slot.

slots.rule: The arrears journey that goes deepest: missed payment, notices, then repaid, written off or passed to an agency
slots.glossary: The debt journey: a bill goes unpaid, then reminders and a payment plan follow, and it ends repaid, written off or with a collection agency.
slots.story: From a missed payment to the end of the debt.
